fields_2.label: Trial team reported onboard for Ops Check of CCS MK II at hrs Checks and trials carried out IAW IHQ MoD(Navy)/DEE approved schedule EE/05/1963 dated 20 Feb 14 and CNO, 07/10 are enumerated in succeeding paragraphs :-

cells.value: Securing of connecting cable and units of the system.
Grounding and AC in the compartment.
Stabilised power supply to the system.
Check ITUs Self-test (By pressing SPL 8 and ENTER).
Check Intercom Operation of all ITUs.
ITUs health check from CCT Desk.
Radio Checks. Remoting of Tx/Rx ST 1075/ Tx/Rx ATRX 1000/ Tx/Rx TR 2400/ Rx EK 896 / V/UHF Tx/Rx PAE 3060/ PAE M7/ SDR NC and check external communication with consort ships.
2.6.5.4 Check simultaneous, Radio and Intercom operation.
